factors.name: nvda_range_vs_aapl_range_2d
factors.hypothesis: Two-day range spread smooths single-day noise while keeping the NVDA vs AAPL turbulence signal.

factors.name: nvda_vol10_minus_aapl_vol10
factors.hypothesis: Realised-vol spread between NVDA and AAPL captures relative risk regime that the daily range spread hints at.

factors.name: nvda_range_vs_aapl_range_times_sign_nvda
factors.formula: multiply(subtract(safe_divide(subtract(NVDA_High, NVDA_Low), NVDA_Close), safe_divide(subtract(AAPL_High, AAPL_Low), AAPL_Close)), sign(pct_change(NVDA_Close, 1)))
factors.hypothesis: Relative NVDA turbulence matters differently on up vs down NVDA days (directional stress).

factors.name: aapl_volume_price_agreement
factors.hypothesis: High volume on up days vs down days signals accumulation or distribution that may persist or reverse.

factors.name: qqq_range_zscore_vs_aapl_range_zscore
factors.hypothesis: Market-wide volatility expansion not shared by AAPL indicates relative calm and possible catch-up moves.

factors.name: msft_nvda_close_position_diff
factors.formula: subtract(safe_divide(subtract(NVDA_Close, NVDA_Low), subtract(NVDA_High, NVDA_Low)), safe_divide(subtract(MSFT_Close, MSFT_Low), subtract(MSFT_High, MSFT_Low)))
factors.hypothesis: Divergence in where peers close within their ranges shows tech-sector intraday sentiment that may lead AAPL.
